_comment: How the game ties to data/npcs/npcs.json (NpcRegistry). speakers: extra exact speaker labels -> NPC ID (list names resolve on their own); speaker_prefixes: labels that start with the key; story_keys: the NPC who speaks a story key's lines (dungeon beats; the .before/.after suffix may be dropped); sides: NPC ID -> 'right' to stand on the right of the dialogue box (default left).
